rationale: Raising to ERROR would hard-fail ll-loop validate on consuming projects' pre-existing loops at upgrade time, a migration this epic did not scope. The per-site # ll-lint: mr11-ok(<var>) marker's own well-formedness check is a separate, new ERROR (unreachable unless a project writes a marker) and does not change MR-11's finding severity. Reconsider once the idiom is documented and has shipped for a release.
rule: MR-11 (unsafe raw interpolation) stays WARNING severity after ENH-3342's widening, not ERROR
